integrity: The all-n assertion is proved by an induced coprime circle rotation; the four-interval example is a finite exhaustive integer-cell permutation with a standalone reproducible checker.
scientific_limitations: Proves exact least periods for R_{n+3,n} for integer n>=1 and one R_{11,7} contrast only; neither classifies all (m,n) nor establishes publication priority beyond inspected material. Finite checks do not replace universal proof.
title: Uniform least periods for three consecutive reciprocal intervals, and a four-interval obstruction
